tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: First World Series for a first-time champion either way: Milwaukee (103-59) swept the Dodgers in the NLCS behind likely Cy Young winner Jacob Misiorowski (16-5, 1.80 ERA), who starts Game 1 against Tampa Bay's Nick Martinez. The Brewers have steamed from -160 to -190 on 81% public run-line tickets — that's a crowd, not sharp money — and no book is giving anything away: the best number on either side is -1.4% EV or worse. Retractable roof, no weather angle.
games.title: World Series Game 1
games.verdict: LEAN: Rays +170 (BetRivers) — no true edge, but the lean is Tampa Bay: the only side the market hasn't overcharged after the public steamed Milwaukee 30 cents.

games.take: Banner-night rematch: Philadelphia spoiled Boston's opener 106-100 behind Paul George's 38-point Celtics debut. Mitchell Robinson (ankle) practiced Thursday and is expected back for New York; Boston is without Devin Carter (mono). The number has sat at -2.5 all week — the market sees these as even with homecourt doing the work.
games.title: Knicks @ Celtics
games.verdict: LEAN: Celtics -2.5 — no true edge, but the lean is Boston: the Garden crowd off a banner-night loss, and the Knicks' frontcourt is still rounding into shape.

games.take: A true coin flip. Anthony Edwards hung 45 in the opener; Orlando is down three rotation bigs (Isaac, Black, Penda) and still practicing without them. ESPN BET briefly hung +110 on Minnesota this morning (+4.0% EV) and corrected to +100 within minutes — the edge evaporated before post time, which is the whole game at these margins.
games.verdict: LEAN: Timberwolves -1.5 — no true edge, but the lean is Minnesota: Orlando's frontcourt is held together with tape and Edwards is in form.

games.take: Ty Jerome dropped a franchise-opener-record 45 in his Memphis debut; the Warriors lost by 22 to the Lakers and are still without Porzingis (away from team), Butler (ACL) and Moody. The line has come down from -4 to -3 on Memphis money. Golden State at home off an embarrassing loss is the classic bounce-back spot, but the roster is thin.
games.verdict: LEAN: Warriors -3 — no true edge, but the lean is Golden State: homecourt off a 22-point loss, against a Memphis team that may have spent its best punch in the opener.

games.take: Rematch of last year's ACC title game (Duke won 27-20 in OT). Both training rooms are full: Duke is down 12 including four offensive linemen and two receivers; Virginia is down 20 including three linemen and its kicker. When both teams are this gutted, take the home team in the revenge spot and the under on a 47 total with backup linemen everywhere.
games.verdict: LEAN: Virginia -2 — no true edge, but the lean is the Cavaliers: at home, revenge spot, and both teams are equally banged up.

games.take: The market already told this story: BetMGM had Army -1.5 three days ago and it's Tulsa -1.5 now, a 3-point flip on Army's injury report (RB Brady Mott out for the season, top pass-catchers questionable) on a short week. The value was the move itself. At the current number, lean the healthier home roster.
games.verdict: LEAN: Tulsa -1.5 — no true edge, but the lean is the Golden Hurricane: the line move already priced Army's injuries, and Tulsa is the healthier team at home.

games.our_fair: Stanford 50.5% / NC State 49.5% (devigged Pinnacle, spread); Over 55.5 fair 50.5%
games.take: Our board play is the total: ESPN BET is hanging +100 on Over 55.5 while Pinnacle, FanDuel and DraftKings all charge -105 to -110 (+0.9% EV). On the side, the line moved toward Stanford (-7 to -6.5) despite 100% of tracked money on NC State — a sharp-vs-public split worth noting with the Wolfpack down three starting linemen and their leading rusher.
games.verdict: LEAN: Stanford +6.5 — no true edge, but the lean is the Cardinal: the line moved their way against the money, and NC State's offensive line is in pieces.

games.take: The battle of LA with one team on crutches: the Clippers are without Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Max Strus and two more rotation pieces. The Lakers' opener was the sharper performance (127-105 over Golden State, Dončić 28/8/7 with a 49-foot buzzer-beater). Nine and a half is a big number, but the talent gap tonight is bigger.
games.verdict: LEAN: Lakers -9.5 — no true edge, but the lean is the Lakers: the Clippers' injury list reads like a starting five, and the Lakers looked the part in their opener.
